decisions.quote: We could also replicate a positive relationship of mental speed with speeded divergent thinking (r = .21) and mental speed with unspeeded divergent thinking (r = .25).
decisions.reason: No prior adjudication or state files exist for this request. The supplied source text consists solely of an abstract (evidence_level: abstract) containing no citations or references. Although the abstract explicitly states that the authors replicated a positive relationship of mental speed with speeded and unspeeded divergent thinking, the abstract alone does not identify the original work(s) and cannot establish whether the retested finding is exclusively shipped row 246 (Preckel, Wermer, & Spinath, 2011, 10.1016/j.intell.2011.06.007) or an omitted original paper.
